features.title: Twelve features. Every one explained — what it does, and exactly what to click.
features.sub: Each card below is a real, working screen in this very system. Pick a role — Citizen, Compliance Officer, or Tech Admin — and follow the three steps.
features.groupCitizen: For citizens — manage your own data
features.groupDpo: For compliance officers — run the privacy programme
features.groupAdmin: For tech admins — wire it into your bank

consents.title: Consents you control
consents.summary: Every purpose the bank wants to process your data for, listed plainly. Each grant is signed and dated; each withdrawal is final.
consents.s1: Sign in at /me with email or DigiLocker.
consents.s2: Open "My consents" — every purpose is a toggle.
consents.s3: Tap to grant or withdraw. Every change is signed and downloadable.

rights.title: Your DPDP rights, on tap
rights.summary: Six rights guaranteed by the DPDP Act: access, correct, erase, withdraw, raise grievance, nominate. We respond inside 30 days.
rights.s2: Pick the right you want to exercise. We guide you through.
rights.s3: Track progress live in /me/requests — SLA bar turns amber at day 21.

notices.title: Notices in your language
notices.summary: Privacy notices translated to every Schedule-8 language, versioned with timestamps, read-aloud on mobile.
notices.s1: Open /me/notices — your preferred language is auto-detected.
notices.s2: Switch language with the EN · മ · हि chip in the header.
notices.s3: Tap the audio icon to hear the notice read aloud.

ropa.title: Records of processing (RoPA)
ropa.summary: A living register of every processing activity — what data, why, how long we keep it, who it's shared with.
ropa.s2: Add a processing activity: name, purpose, retention, data categories.
ropa.s3: Link high-risk activities to a DPIA for assessment.

dpia.title: AI-assisted impact assessments
dpia.summary: The platform drafts every DPIA risk for you. You review, score, and sign — minutes instead of hours.
dpia.s1: In /admin/dpia, click "+ New DPIA" and link a processing activity.
dpia.s2: Hit "AI prefill" — every risk answer is drafted instantly.
dpia.s3: Adjust likelihood / impact, sign as DPO. Legal + CISO co-sign.

breach.title: 72-hour breach clock
breach.summary: Auto-starts the moment an incident is logged. The DPB India notification PDF is pre-filled for you.
breach.s2: Enter severity, affected count, categories — the 72-hour clock starts.
breach.s3: Download the pre-filled DPB notification, mark "Reported".

audit.title: Tamper-evident audit chain
audit.summary: Every action is SHA-256 hash-chained and RS256-signed. Court-admissible. Verifiable in seconds.
audit.s1: Every mutation appends one row to the chain — automatic.
audit.s2: Open /admin/audit to see the full signed timeline.
audit.s3: Click "Verify chain integrity" — confirms zero tampering.

reports.title: Reports & board pack
reports.summary: One click and you have a quarterly compliance report — KPIs, per-module status, sign-offs — formatted for the board.
reports.s2: Pick a date range and the modules to include.
reports.s3: Download the PDF + JSON — ready for filing and archival.

publishNotices.title: Manage privacy notices
publishNotices.summary: Publish, version, translate, and revoke privacy notices — all 22 Schedule-8 languages from one place.
publishNotices.s2: Write in English; the system drafts every regional translation.
publishNotices.s3: Review, approve, publish — citizens see it instantly.

cookies.title: Cookie consent, granular
cookies.summary: Scan any URL, categorise every cookie, publish a banner that honours consent before any tracker fires.
cookies.s2: The scanner proposes essential / functional / analytics / marketing buckets.
cookies.s3: Review categories, publish — the banner enforces choices on every page.

connectors.title: Connectors you already use
connectors.summary: DigiLocker, Account Aggregator, Finacle, NPCI, KSCB CBS — connected by config, not by integration projects.
connectors.s3: Consent-enforcement checks run automatically before every data pull.

rbac.title: Role-based access (RBAC)
rbac.summary: Who can see what, who can sign what, who can publish what — down to the column.
rbac.s1: Open /admin/rbac to see every role and its permission scope.
rbac.s2: Assign users to roles — changes apply across all modules.
rbac.s3: Audit every permission grant in the signed audit trail.

sovereign.title: Sovereign & portable
sovereign.summary: KSCB owns the platform end to end. Deploy on bank infrastructure of your choosing. Customise anything. Zero vendor lock-in.
sovereign.s1: Receive the deployment package from KSCB IT.
sovereign.s2: Configure database + authentication in one config file.
sovereign.s3: Deploy on KSCB infrastructure — each branch and subsidiary isolated by audit chain.

tenancy.title: Tenancy & branches
tenancy.summary: One DPCMS install can serve KSCB + every branch + every subsidiary, each in its own audit chain.
tenancy.s2: Add a tenant or branch with its own org-id and DPO.
tenancy.s3: Data segregation, audit isolation, and reports all happen automatically.

day.title: Three roles. One platform. Clear daily playbook for each.
day.sub: Hand this page to a new joiner and they'll be productive on day one.
day.adminTitle: Set it up once. Keep it healthy.

citizen.what: Sign in once with DigiLocker or email. Two-factor optional.
Toggle the discretionary consents you're comfortable with.
Withdraw a consent in one tap. Withdrawals propagate in under 60 seconds.
File a DSR — access, correction, erasure, grievance, nomination.
Re-read the privacy notice in Malayalam. Audio supported.

dpo.what: Open /admin — check the 72-hour clock, DSR SLA bar, and DPIA queue.
Approve DPIAs (AI has drafted them — you review and sign).
Open the breach, download the pre-filled DPB notification, mark "Reported".
Run "Verify chain integrity" in /admin/audit. Archive the report.
Generate the board pack in /admin/reporting — file with DPB India.

admin.what: Add tenants and branches in /admin/settings. Assign DPO + admin roles.
Wire each connector in /admin/integrations and test the handshake.
Run cookie scans on every public website in /admin/cookies.
Review RBAC roles. Audit user assignments.
Monitor audit volume — chain growth is the heartbeat of the system.

setup.title: Three minutes from sign-in to first signed consent.
setup.s1Caption: Use DigiLocker or email. Two-factor optional but encouraged. We never store your password — auth happens via a one-way verifiable token.
setup.s2Caption: Each grant is timestamped, signed (RS256), and downloadable as evidence. The audit trail records who consented, when, and from which device.
setup.s3Caption: Withdrawals propagate to every connected system in under 60 seconds. The bank receives the new instruction immediately — no human in the loop.

arch.body: Every architectural decision is documented. Every dependency is auditable. Every cryptographic choice is explained. KSCB owns the stack — top to bottom.

doors.eyebrow: Two sides of the same system
doors.title: One platform. Two front doors.
doors.sub: Below is the full inventory of what you get when you walk through each door. Every item is a working screen — not a roadmap promise.
doors.citizenCaption: A clean mobile portal where every consent is a toggle and every right is a button. Available in Malayalam, English, and Hindi — read or listen.
doors.dpoCaption: One cockpit for the DPO and her team — every privacy obligation under the DPDP Act is a screen here, with the data already wired up.

citizenFeatures.name: Privacy notices

dpoFeatures.name: Cookie consent

dpoFeatures.name: Privacy notices

dpoFeatures.name: Data principal rights

dpoFeatures.name: Research repository
dpoFeatures.desc: every DPDP / DPB India / RBI / NPCI / MeitY reference document, searchable and linked from compliance pages.

dpoFeatures.name: Audit trail

dpoFeatures.name: RBAC viewer

dpoFeatures.name: Tenancy & settings
dpoFeatures.desc: one install serves KSCB headquarters, every branch, every subsidiary — each with its own audit chain.
